Name: Животные носят шляпы
Description: Cosmetic hats for dogs, cats and pigs. Choose a top hat or the original in-game Hat, then pick a palette color or enter a custom RGB hex code. Standalone; English and Russian included. Special for Elisabeth.
DescriptionSteam:
[h1]Pets Wear Hats[/h1]
A little extra personality for the animals aboard your ship.

Dress your dogs, cats and pigs in a top hat or the original in-game Hat, then choose a color to suit them. Give every pet its own look, from a respectable ship's cat to a very distinguished pig.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Hats for player-owned dogs, cats and pigs.
[*]An included top hat and the original Stardeus Hat.
[*]A headwear selector in the animal's management overview.
[*]Choose a palette color or enter a custom RGB hex code, such as #74B7DD.
[*]Change or remove a hat at any time.
[*]Hat selection and tint use the game's native appearance save data.
[*]English and Russian translations.
[/list]

[h2]How to Use[/h2]
[list]
[*]Subscribe, enable the mod in the Mods menu and restart Stardeus.
[*]Select a dog, cat or pig belonging to your colony.
[*]Open its management overview and find Animals Wear Hats.
[*]Choose Headwear, then use Color to change its tint.
[/list]
No direct-control chip is required.

[h2]Cosmetic Accessories[/h2]
Hats are selected directly in the animal's overview. They do not consume an inventory item, require crafting or change the animal's stats.

The original Hat's graphics are loaded from Stardeus. This mod does not include copies of the game's artwork.

[h2]Compatibility and Notes[/h2]
This is a standalone mod for Stardeus 0.15. g33kUI is not required.

Hats currently appear on animals in the world; portrait hats are not included. Fitting can vary between species and poses, and cats, pigs and the original Hat may need further adjustment. If an original Hat animation variant is missing, the normal sprite for that direction is used.

Mods that change the same animal appearance layers or add headwear equipment slots may need compatibility adjustments. The mod avoids overwriting other accessories and existing headwear slots.

If you report a problem, please include the animal species, hat, screenshot, game and mod versions, and Player.log when relevant.
